basic_details.short_information: KMRL has issued its Apprenticeship Recruitment Notification 2026-27 for 70 apprenticeship positions across technical, non-technical, diploma and ITI trades. The overview below summarizes the vacancies, qualifications, age, stipend, training period, eligibility restrictions, application process, selection procedure and official contact details. content_sections.heading: KMRL Apprentice Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Register for Job Alerts ↗ Official Notification PDF Recruitment includes 16 Graduate Technical, 6 Graduate Non-Technical, 28 Diploma Technician and 20 ITI Trade Apprentice positions. Candidates must register through NAPS/NATS and submit the prescribed application form with required documents to KMRL's corporate office by 10 November 2026. No application fee, written examination or interview is required.

content_sections.heading: Kochi Metro Rail Recruitment 2026 Important Dates
content_sections.text: Kochi Metro Rail Limited started accepting applications for the Apprenticeship Programme 2026-27 on 15 October 2026. Candidates must complete the required NAPS or NATS registration and submit the prescribed application form by 10 November 2026.

content_sections.heading: Kochi Metro Rail Apprentice Vacancy 2026
content_sections.text: KMRL has announced 70 apprenticeship vacancies divided among graduate, diploma and ITI categories. Diploma Technician apprentices account for the largest share, with 28 positions, followed by 20 ITI Trade Apprentice positions. All selected apprentices will additionally receive a food/messing allowance of Rs. 1,200 per month, as stated in the notification.

content_sections.heading: Kochi Metro Rail Recruitment 2026 Category-wise Vacancy
content_sections.text: The notification provides the following reservation-wise distribution for 70 apprenticeship positions. Vacancy Clarification: The category-wise entries printed in the official notification contain an arithmetic inconsistency. The five reservation figures displayed against Graduate Technical add up to 15, although the row total is 16. Summing the printed category entries also differs from the advertised total-row category figures. The advertised category totals are reproduced above without inventing corrections. Candidates should consult KMRL for clarification of the reservation distribution.

content_sections.heading: Kochi Metro Rail Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Candidates applying for Kochi Metro Rail Apprenticeship Recruitment 2026 must have completed the relevant qualification through a full-time regular course from a government-recognized institution. Educational qualifications obtained through part-time, correspondence, distance education or online modes are not accepted. Applicants must have completed a full-time regular four-year B.Tech or B.E. degree in one of the engineering disciplines notified by KMRL. Applicants must possess a full-time regular three-year degree in BBA, B.Com or BCA from a recognized institution. Candidates must possess a full-time regular three-year engineering diploma in the relevant notified discipline. Applicants must have completed a full-time regular ITI course in the relevant advertised trade. Candidates must have passed the qualifying examination within five years from the application closing date of 10 November 2026. The notification also requires candidates to be medically fit under the provisions of the Apprentices Act, 1961. Candidates awaiting final examination results. Candidates who have not completed 18 years of age. Candidates who have already undergone apprenticeship training in any organization for any duration. Candidates currently undergoing apprenticeship training. Candidates whose qualification was obtained through part-time education. Candidates holding correspondence, distance education or online-mode qualifications. Candidates who do not meet the prescribed qualification or medical fitness requirements.

content_sections.heading: Kochi Metro Rail Age Limit 2026
content_sections.text: KMRL requires apprenticeship applicants to have completed 18 years of age. Candidates below 18 years are not eligible.

content_sections.heading: Kochi Metro Rail Apprentice Stipend 2026
content_sections.text: The monthly stipend depends on the apprentice's qualification category. Graduate apprentices receive Rs. 12,300, diploma apprentices Rs. 10,900 and ITI trade apprentices Rs. 9,600. An additional Rs. 1,200 per month is payable as food/messing allowance. The notification states that Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) under the NATS scheme will provide Rs. 6,150 for graduate apprentices and Rs. 5,450 for diploma apprentices. The remaining applicable stipend will be paid through KMRL's arrangements, as prescribed. The DBT amounts form part of the notified monthly stipends and are not additional payments.

content_sections.heading: Kochi Metro Rail Apprenticeship Training Period 2026
content_sections.text: Selected candidates will undergo apprenticeship training for a period of one year from their date of joining. The training will end automatically upon completion of the one-year period, and no extension is permitted.

content_sections.heading: Kochi Metro Rail Recruitment 2026 Application Fee
content_sections.text: Kochi Metro Rail Limited has confirmed that there is no application fee for the Apprenticeship Programme 2026-27.

content_sections.heading: Kochi Metro Rail Apprentice Selection Process 2026
content_sections.text: The KMRL Apprenticeship Recruitment 2026 selection process does not include a written examination or interview. Candidates will be shortlisted from the applications received and called for verification of original documents and certificates. Application Screening: KMRL will review applications for completeness and eligibility. Shortlisting: Eligible candidates will be shortlisted for document verification. Certificate Verification: Candidates must present their original qualification, identity and other prescribed documents. Medical Fitness and Police Verification: Selected candidates must satisfy the applicable requirements before engagement. Apprenticeship Contract: Engagement will require acceptance of the tripartite apprenticeship contract through the NATS/NAPS system. Incomplete or ineligible applications will be rejected without individual intimation.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Kochi Metro Rail Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: KMRL has prescribed a two-stage application process. Candidates must first obtain the applicable NAPS or NATS registration number and then submit the completed Apprentice Bio-Data Form with required documents to the KMRL office. ITI candidates must register as Candidate/Student on the NAPS portal at https://apprenticeshipindia.gov.in/ . Graduate and Diploma candidates must enrol under NATS at https://nats.education.gov.in/ . Complete or update the applicant profile on the applicable portal. Upload the required qualification and supporting documents. Obtain the NAPS/NATS registration or enrolment number. Download or print the Apprentice Bio-Data Form attached to the official notification. Enter the NAPS/NATS registration or enrolment number. Select the applicable apprenticeship category and trade or discipline. Complete the personal, educational and contact details in CAPITAL LETTERS as instructed. Affix a passport-size photograph. Fill in the educational qualification information and sign the declaration. Attach the prescribed documents, including proof of NAPS/NATS registration. Submit or send the completed application in the attached format to the KMRL office address. Ensure the application reaches the prescribed office within the notified application period.

content_sections.heading: Kochi Metro Rail Apprentice Application Submission Address
content_sections.text: General Manager (HR, ADM & TRG) Kochi Metro Rail Ltd., Corporate Office, 4th Floor, JLN Stadium Metro Station, Kaloor, Kochi, Kerala - 682017. Last Date: 10 November 2026. Important: Applications must be submitted using the official attached bio-data format. KMRL does not accept alternative application formats or modes.

content_sections.heading: Kochi Metro Rail Apprentice Documents Required 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates must attach the required registration, qualification and identity documents when submitting the application.

rows.requirement: Matriculation Certificate, Aadhaar Card, Passport or Accepted Document

content_sections.heading: Kochi Metro Rail Apprentice Bio-Data Form 2026
content_sections.text: The official recruitment notification contains a two-page Apprentice Bio-Data Form. Candidates must complete the form in CAPITAL LETTERS and mark the relevant apprenticeship trade or category. The form requests: NAPS/NATS Enrolment ID. Apprenticeship category and selected trade or discipline. Applicant's full name and father's name. Marital status and date of birth. Nationality, religion and category. Whether the candidate's father or mother is employed by KMRL. Permanent and mailing postal addresses. Phone number and email address. Educational qualifications, institution, branch and duration. Blood group. Extracurricular activities, if any. Candidate's declaration, date, place and signature. The applicant should complete only the candidate-related sections. Fields marked for office use are to be completed by KMRL.

faq.question: Q1. What is the total number of vacancies in KMRL Apprentice Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 70 vacancies available for various Graduate, Diploma, and ITI Trade apprentice posts.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to submit the application form?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the offline application form is 10 November 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the monthly stipend for Graduate Apprentices?
faq.answer: Graduate Apprentices receive a monthly stipend of Rs. 12,300/- (including DBT) along with an additional 1200/- food/messing allowance.

faq.question: Q4. What is the training period for KMRL apprentices?
faq.answer: The apprenticeship training tenure is one year from the date of joining.

faq.question: Q5. How can I apply for this apprenticeship?
faq.answer: Candidates must first register on the NAPS or NATS portal, complete their profile, and then send the filled application form by post to the Kochi corporate office.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee?
faq.answer: There is no application fee, written examination, or interview process for applicants.

faq.question: Q7. What is the age requirement to apply?
faq.answer: Candidates must not have completed the 18 years of age.

faq.question: Q8. Where should the application form be sent?
faq.answer: Applications must be sent by post to General Manager (HR, ADMN & TRG), Kochi Metro Rail Ltd., Corporate Office, 4th Floor, JLN Stadium Metro Station, Kaloor, Kochi, Kerala - 682017.

faq.question: Q9. Does successful completion guarantee employment?
faq.answer: On completion of apprenticeship training, the candidate will not have any right to claim for employment.
